svg.text: El Nino costs good years, but we cannot prove it here
Each of 228 place-crop pairs: how much lower the good-year share is in El Nino seasons, against Fisher's exact p.
GOOD-YEAR SHARE: EL NINO MINUS OTHER SEASONS
The cloud sits left of zero, which is the expected direction, and mostly above p = 0.05, which is what too few El Nino seasons looks like.
